title: Jacobian Conjecture
status: Resolved for dimensions ≥ 3 in 2026; the plane case remains open
statusZh: 2026 年解决三维及以上情形；二维情形仍开放
author: Ott-Heinrich Keller

overview.summary: Can a polynomial map be locally invertible everywhere yet fail to be globally injective? OPBench asks models for explicit maps and finite collision witnesses that an offline symbolic program can check.
overview.summaryZh: 一个多项式映射能否处处局部可逆，却不是全局单射？OPBench 要求模型提交可由离线符号程序核验的显式映射与有限碰撞见证。

visualization.label: Three locally invertible sheets can share one target
visualization.labelZh: 三个局部可逆薄片可以映到同一目标
visualization.caption: The 2026 three-dimensional certificate combines a nonzero constant Jacobian with three rational points in one fiber.
visualization.captionZh: 2026 年的三维证书同时给出非零常雅可比与同一纤维中的三个有理点。

statement.intro: For a polynomial map over the complex numbers,
statement.introZh: 对于复数域上的多项式映射，
statement.explanation: the conjecture asserted that $F$ is a polynomial automorphism. A counterexample supplies distinct points $p\ne q$ with $F(p)=F(q)$.
statement.explanationZh: 原猜想断言 $F$ 必为多项式自同构。反例则需给出不同点 $p\ne q$，满足 $F(p)=F(q)$。
statement.note: Every displayed result is checked by an offline symbolic program. No LLM judge decides the algebraic verdict.
statement.noteZh: 所有展示结果均由离线符号程序核验，不使用 LLM judge 判定代数结论。

atlas.title: From Keller's question to auditable counterexamples
atlas.titleZh: 从 Keller 的问题到可审计反例
atlas.body: The frontier changed in July 2026: dimension three is false, stabilization settles every higher dimension, and dimension two remains the open core.
atlas.bodyZh: 2026 年 7 月前沿发生变化：三维命题为假，稳定化处理覆盖全部更高维度，二维仍是开放核心。

events.title: Keller formulates the problem
events.description: A nonzero constant Jacobian is conjectured to force polynomial invertibility.
events.descriptionZh: 猜想认为非零常雅可比必然推出多项式可逆。

events.title: Degree reduction reshapes the search
events.titleZh: 次数归约重塑搜索空间
events.description: Bass, Connell, and Wright reduce the general problem to special cubic-homogeneous maps.
events.descriptionZh: Bass、Connell 与 Wright 将一般问题归约到特殊的三次齐次映射。

events.title: A three-dimensional certificate is independently formalized
events.titleZh: 三维证书得到独立形式化
events.description: An explicit degree-seven map has determinant −2 and three distinct rational preimages of one point; Isabelle/HOL verifies the finite claims.
events.descriptionZh: 一个七次显式映射的行列式恒为 −2，且三个不同有理点具有同一像；Isabelle/HOL 核验了有限证书。

events.title: The geometry and higher-degree families are developed
events.titleZh: 几何机制与高几何度数族得到发展
events.description: A self-contained tangent-sweep account gives examples in every dimension above two and of arbitrarily large geometric degree.
events.descriptionZh: 切线扫描机制给出自足解释，并构造所有三维以上、任意大几何度数的反例。

benchmark.name: OPBench · Jacobian Counterexample Construction
benchmark.title: Five problems, one capability curve
benchmark.titleZh: 五级问题，一条能力曲线
benchmark.body: The suite moves from unconstrained construction to degree, fiber-size, and open two-dimensional frontiers. Every task uses the same exact certificate protocol.
benchmark.bodyZh: 题目从开放构造推进到次数、纤维大小及二维开放前沿，并共享同一套精确证书协议。
benchmark.hintNote: Each problem is evaluated both without a hint and with a reference-direction hint.
benchmark.hintNoteZh: 每道题均同时评测无提示与参考方向提示两种设置。
benchmark.footer: Novelty and exact generic-fiber degree are reported separately when they are not machine-verifiable; neither is delegated to an LLM judge.
benchmark.footerZh: 创新性与精确的一般纤维度数在无法程序判定时单独报告，且均不交给 LLM judge。

tasks.title: Open Construction
tasks.subtitle: Complex dimension 3 · no degree bound
tasks.significance: Tests invention together with exact certificate construction.
tasks.significanceZh: 同时测试结构创新与精确证书构造。
tasks.questionZh: 在三维复空间中构造反例；不限制次数，但必须提交可核验碰撞证书。

tasks.title: Degree-Seven Rediscovery
tasks.subtitle: Complex dimension 3 · degree ≤ 7
tasks.significance: A controlled target tests whether a model can reconstruct the known mechanism.
tasks.significanceZh: 受控目标测试模型能否重建已知机制。
tasks.questionZh: 构造三维反例，分量最高次数不超过 7，并给出至少两个不同碰撞点。

tasks.title: Lower-Degree Frontier
tasks.subtitle: Complex dimension 3 · improve degree 7
tasks.subtitleZh: 三维 · 改进七次纪录
tasks.significance: Beating degree seven would expose a simpler counterexample geometry.
tasks.significanceZh: 突破七次将揭示更简洁的反例几何。
tasks.questionZh: 构造最高次数严格低于 7 的三维复多项式反例。

tasks.title: Four-Sheet Frontier
tasks.subtitle: Generic fiber degree 4 · degree ≤ 11
tasks.subtitleZh: 一般纤维度数 4 · 次数 ≤ 11
tasks.significance: Tests joint control of fiber geometry and algebraic complexity.
tasks.significanceZh: 测试对纤维几何与代数复杂度的联合控制。
tasks.questionZh: 构造一般纤维度数为 4、最高次数不超过 11 的三维反例。
constraintsZh: 一般纤维度数 = 4 目标

tasks.title: Two-Dimensional Frontier
tasks.subtitle: Complex dimension 2 · no degree bound
tasks.significance: Dimension two is the remaining unresolved Jacobian frontier.
tasks.significanceZh: 二维是雅可比问题仍未解决的核心前沿。
tasks.questionZh: 在二维复空间中构造一个可由确定性程序核验的反例。

evaluation.title: Exact outcomes across tasks, models, and hint modes
evaluation.titleZh: 跨题目、模型与提示模式的精确结果
evaluation.body: Outcome types are derived from deterministic verifier fields, while transport failures are separated from mathematical failures.
evaluation.bodyZh: 结果类型由确定性验证字段导出，传输失败与数学失败分开统计。

symbolicLab.title: Certificate contract and offline verification
symbolicLab.body: Every problem uses the same polynomial-map certificate; task-specific degree and fiber requirements are then checked on top.
symbolicLab.bodyZh: 所有题目采用同一多项式映射证书，再叠加各题的次数与纤维约束。
